html:
After a long time without astrophotography, here is a new version of the Leo Triplet.

The Leo Triplet is a group of galaxies made up of the spiral galaxies M65, M66, and NGC 3628. It is located about 35 light-years away, in the constellation Leo.

Previous version



Technical details:

Date: 2010-03-08
Temperature: 2 to 0 degrees celsius.
Telescope: Takahashi SKY90II refractor @ f4.5
Sensor: Canon 40D unfiltered by Jacques Chagnon
Filter: IDAS-LPS (to counter light pollution)
Mount: LX200 10" f 6.3 classic
Guiding: QHY5 on 170 mm finder and PHD

25 frames of 300 seconds, 25 darks, 25 flats, 25 bias
Calibrated and stacked in DeepSkyStacker
Processing in photoshop
